summary: Cold blind screening audit of the Version 2 manuscript (/Users/o2satz/antigravity/imboreceipt/manuscript) confirms full compliance for arXiv and Preprints.org submission with zero blockers. Sole human authorship (Wayne A. Satz, MD), explicit Google Antigravity / Gemini workflow disclosure with human verification, Google Antigravity for Science program acknowledgment, 45 CFR 46.102(e) IRB non-applicability framing, absence of unhedged prospective clinical claims, and mathematical/empirical alignment across Theorem 1, Propositions 1-2, Tables 1-7, Figures 1-4, and source/checkpoint artifacts are all verified.

warnings.detail: Scania APS, Home Credit Default Risk, and IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection are attributed via direct UCI/Kaggle URLs in the Data and Code Availability Statement rather than formal BibTeX entries in references.bib (unlike UCI Diabetes, UCI Taiwan, NeurIPS BAF, and OpenML).

The parenthetical full-cohort training size range 'N_train approx 54k-77k' reflects the four larger cohorts, whereas across all six cohorts under the 55% training split N_train spans 16.5k-77k (including Scania APS at 41.8k and UCI Taiwan at 16.5k).

In Appendix Table 6 (Home Credit), total native channel count M=26 matches the code, but the prose breakdown lists '4 bureau, 3 POS_CASH, 3 installments' whereas fine_grained_cohorts.py defines 5 bureau/inquiry channels, 1 POS_CASH channel, and 4 installments channels (also summing to 26) on a 140k-row subsample of the 307,511-borrower table.
